record.text: Feels more like a normal Raptors game. Aggressive defense is going to create fouls.
Raptors string together some stops -- a rare occurrence tonight -- and creep back within 4 with 5:20 left in the third quarter

I thought that was gonna be Kyle Anderson at the start of the offseason and was really bummed/worried when he signed with the raptors. And when we signed Lyles I was like, at least he’s a warm body over 6-8, but he’ll never play. Glad to be wrong.

The Raptors are always going to be a team that fouls a lot. They're aggressive & prioritize steals/deflections. Fouls are the tradeoff. Would imagine/hope it levels off as they figure out what they can get away with & the league's points of emphasis are inevitably de-emphasized.
When could Kawhi return to the Raptors' lineup? (via TSN)
raptors minus kawhi are just the nets.

Reasons why I'm drawing dinosaurs:

1. Bored due to no AO3

2. Kinda testing everyone's patience because it's a thing I do.

3. All that gay shit is illegal where I'm from anyway, might as well fuck raptors, not much difference.
Of note, half of the Raptors are in foul trouble. Could become a problem...

However, difference in the game is shooting. Doubtful that ORL continues to shoot 62% from three.

Raptors can hope that fewer FT and made threes for ORL help tighten the gap

Raptors have 52 shots to Magic's 34, Magic have 24 FTA to Raps' 11 at halftime (64-55).

In terms of Raps' KPIs, only 3 points off turnovers and 5 fastbreak points. 

And just gotta get more 3s up, 3/13 first half.

This close-up portrait photograph of a Barn Owl seen perched on a textured tree branch resting while out hunting over farmland at dusk. The owl has a distinct, bright white, heart-shaped facial disc framed by large, dark, ink-black eyes and a small beak. Its soft, fluffy chest plumage is a stark white, while its back and wings display a rich pattern of tan, gold, and gray feathers mottled with small dark spots.
Throughout history, the Barn Owl has earned eerie nicknames like "ghost owl" and "graveyard owl" due to it looking like a pale, floating apparition gliding, completely silent as it hunts in low light.  The barn owl also emits a piercing, unearthly screech instead of an owl like hoot!

Halftime: #Magic 64, Raptors 55

Franz Wagner with 18 points, Desmond Bane 14, Wendell Carter Jr. 13 and Anthony Black 11.

Bane made four 3s and Orlando shot 8-for-13 from distance while Toronto shot 3-for-13.

Scottie Barnes has 23 points but 3 fouls for Toronto.

Scottie Barnes' career-high for field goal attempts in a game is 29. He took 24 shots in tonight's first half alone. It's the most he's ever attempted in a half (his previous high was 16!)

He's scored 23 of the Raptors' 55 points.

value.text: Barnes has taken 22 of the Raptors' 49 first-half shots and, well, he's needed to. Scottie bully ball at the rim is basically the only thing that's working, so far. Toronto is 3-for-13 from 3. Magic shooting 8-for-13.
